summary: GrowInLove is an Internet Computer (ICP) Motoko canister + React single-page app for couples to strengthen their relationship through daily ritual prompts. Users authenticate via Internet Identity, create a profile, pair with a partner using a 6‑digit code, submit daily ritual responses (text/emoji and optional shared photo), and browse a reverse‑chronological “Memories”/Ritual History of past rituals. The app includes a Love Languages quiz with partner synchronization (polling-based) and an Insights dashboard UI (streak/harmony/badges/trends) that is wired end-to-end but still needs launch-blocker backend fixes to make analytics/badges fully data-driven and reliable. An Activities tab provides client-side experiences (spin wheel, unlockable activity packs, challenges/rewards) gated by pairing/quiz completion with admin overrides.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication context (login/logout + identity restore)
existing_features.description: Provides a React context for Internet Identity authentication, restores delegations on reload, exposes login/logout actions and status flags, and supports long-lived sessions (TTL).

existing_features.title: Identity-bound canister actor creation with access-control bootstrap
existing_features.description: Creates an anonymous actor when unauthenticated and an identity-bound actor when authenticated. On authenticated actor creation, calls a backend bootstrap method to initialize role assignment using an env-provided admin token plus a caller-provided secret read from the URL hash/session.

existing_features.title: Role-based access control (guest/user/admin) with admin role assignment
existing_features.description: Backend maintains a principal→role map. Admin is bootstrapped via CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN; admins can assign roles to other principals. Frontend can query admin status for gating/overrides.

existing_features.title: Profile onboarding and profile editing
existing_features.description: Authenticated users must initialize a profile (name). Profiles can be saved/updated, while partnerId/role/isFirstUser are protected from direct modification (pairing flow required).

existing_features.title: Tab-based SPA shell with top bar + bottom navigation
existing_features.description: Implements a multi-tab single-page experience (Home/Insights/Memories/Activities/Us/Love Languages) with gated rendering based on authentication and profile existence.

existing_features.title: Partner pairing via 6-digit code (generate/check/complete)
existing_features.description: Users generate a 6-digit code, share/copy it, and complete pairing to mutually link partnerId in both profiles. UI includes robust error messaging for common pairing failures.

existing_features.title: Canonical couple identity and mutual-partner authorization
existing_features.description: Backend derives a canonical coupleId from sorted principal text and requires mutual pairing for couple-scoped reads/writes (rituals, photos, quiz combined state).

existing_features.title: Daily ritual prompt selection with love-language focus theming
existing_features.description: Backend lazily initializes a fixed prompt set and deterministically selects the daily prompt by day-number modulo prompt count. Frontend renders a themed hero card based on the prompt’s love language.

existing_features.title: Ritual submission with optional text, emoji, and photo attachment
existing_features.description: Users submit daily ritual responses containing optional text, emoji, and an optional photoId (uploaded first via a blob upload endpoint).

existing_features.title: Ritual completion status with canonical partner attribution and polling sync
existing_features.description: Backend returns daily completion status using canonical (partnerA/partnerB) ordering; frontend derives caller-vs-partner completion and polls frequently to update “waiting/both completed” UI states.

existing_features.title: Ritual completion celebration animation overlay
existing_features.description: Displays a floating-hearts overlay when both partners complete a ritual, designed with memoized heart generation to reduce re-renders and improve animation performance.

existing_features.title: Multi-day ritual history storage and retrieval (limit + newest-first)
existing_features.description: Backend stores one entry per couple per day and merges both partners’ submissions into a single entry. History retrieval supports limits and returns newest-first; frontend defensively sorts newest-first as well.

existing_features.title: Home ritual history UI with modal drill-in and inline photo rendering
existing_features.description: Home shows a ritual history list, supports viewing full prompt/responses in a modal, and renders linked photos by fetching photo blobs via photoId.

existing_features.title: Memories scrapbook page with progressive loading
existing_features.description: Read-only scrapbook view of ritual history with expand/collapse per entry, inline photos, and incremental pagination by increasing the getRitualHistory(limit) parameter.

existing_features.title: Shared photo storage and access control (upload/get/list/delete)
existing_features.description: Stores photos as blobs with owner metadata. Access is restricted to owner, mutual partner, or admin. UI supports uploading, fetching, and deleting photos (owner/admin).

existing_features.title: Love Languages quiz (7 questions) with persistence, sharing, reset/retake
existing_features.description: Implements a multi-step quiz, computes rankings, saves results to the backend, reloads saved results, supports retake/reset with confirmation, and supports sharing via Web Share/clipboard.

existing_features.title: Partner quiz synchronization state with polling and defensive fallback
existing_features.description: Backend exposes combined quiz completion/results for a couple and a partner-state endpoint with authorization. Frontend polls to detect partner completion, shows waiting/synced banners, and falls back safely if partner-state fetch fails.

existing_features.title: Insights dashboard UI (streak/harmony/trends/badges) with truthful data guards
existing_features.description: Renders a backend-driven insights dashboard with gated sections and “not enough data yet” handling for trend visualization. Includes milestone badge progress UI and a celebration overlay when a new badge unlock is detected.

existing_features.title: Harmony UI utilities and cross-tab navigation shortcuts
existing_features.description: Provides helpers to normalize 7-day trend series and label trends, plus compact harmony echo on Home that navigates/auto-scrolls to the Insights harmony section.

existing_features.title: Activities hub with spin wheel, unlockable love-language packs, and admin override
existing_features.description: Client-side Activities UI includes a weighted spin wheel (biased by shared top love languages when both quizzes are complete) with daily localStorage persistence, unlockable activity packs gated by streak (admin can unlock all), and placeholders for challenges/reward progress visuals.

existing_features.title: Standardized loading, empty, and error states across major surfaces
existing_features.description: Shared UI building blocks for consistent loading/empty/error states with optional retry actions and technical details disclosure, used to improve UX clarity across data-driven tabs.

existing_features.title: Frontend UX polish for recovery and responsiveness (non-React-Query changes)
existing_features.description: Implements UX-copy clarity, safer recovery paths for failed canister calls (e.g., retry sync), and lightweight performance tweaks (memoization/refs/will-change/reduced motion) without changing React Query provider/setup semantics.

existing_features.title: Manual QA acceptance checklist for end-to-end verification
existing_features.description: Repository includes a comprehensive manual QA checklist covering authentication, profile setup, pairing, rituals, quiz sync, insights, loading/empty/error states, performance, and accessibility checks.

existing_features.title: Blob-storage maintenance and dead-blob pruning endpoints (Caffeine storage integration)
existing_features.description: Includes operational endpoints for updating authorized gateway principals, querying dead blobs, confirming pruning, and refilling a cashier canister with cycles (with authorization checks on most operations).

existing_features.title: URL hash secret extraction with session persistence and URL cleanup
existing_features.description: Provides utilities to read sensitive parameters from the URL hash, persist them in sessionStorage, and remove them from the address bar via history.replaceState to reduce accidental leakage.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix Insights backend to return real streak/harmony/trend analytics (replace placeholder values)
Wire badge milestone unlocking to real backend metrics (streak-based badges, harmony-based badges)
Finalize streak computation logic (both partners complete same day, deterministic resets on missed days) and ensure it updates from ritual history
Make prompt initialization deterministic across all prompt-read endpoints (ensure prompts never empty / 'preparing')
Add pairing-code TTL/expiration enforcement (validate on check + complete)
Add authorization to blob-storage maintenance endpoint _caffeineStorageUpdateGatewayPrincipals (admin-only)
Fix env var typo risk (CAFFFEINE_STORAGE_CASHIER_PRINCIPAL) to prevent runtime traps/misconfigurations
Harden Storage.refillCashier to avoid Nat.sub underflow traps when balance < reserved cycles

Implement deterministic prompt initialization for all prompt-read endpoints by ensuring internalInitPrompts() is invoked before returning prompt data (at minimum: fetchPrompts() and getPromptsByLoveLanguage()).
Add pairing-code expiration (TTL) enforcement so pairing codes can expire and are treated as invalid/expired at both checkPairingCode(code) and completePairing(code).

Finalize and correct streak computation so the current streak and longest streak are computed from real ritual history for the couple, with deterministic resets on missed days and with "completed" meaning both partners submitted for the day.

Update streak-related state deterministically as part of ritual submission so streak/insights do not rely on placeholder or stale caches; streak must reflect the couple’s actual stored ritualEntries and update when a day transitions to "both completed".

Replace placeholder analytics in getInsightsData() with real computations derived from couple ritual history and quiz data, returning populated values for: currentStreak, longestStreak, averageHarmony, currentHarmony, recentCompletionRate, last14DayTrend, last30DayTrend, and harmonyTrend.

Implement real badge milestone logic so getBadgeMilestones() returns milestone progress based on real computed metrics and milestone flags use monotonic "flip-to-true" behavior once earned (7/30/100 streak and Harmony Elite).
Add missing authorization to the blob-storage maintenance endpoint _caffeineStorageUpdateGatewayPrincipals so only admins can invoke it.

Harden storage env-var and cycles refill logic by (1) fixing the cashier principal env var typo risk (CAFFFEINE_STORAGE_CASHIER_PRINCIPAL vs CAFFEINE_STORAGE_CASHIER_PRINCIPAL) with safe fallback behavior, and (2) preventing Nat.sub underflow traps in Storage.refillCashier when the canister balance is below reserved cycles (use saturating/guarded math).

architectural_notes: Backend is a single Motoko canister that composes cross-cutting concerns via mixins (authorization and blob-storage maintenance).
Backend enforces role-based access control (guest/user/admin) using a principal→role map; the first eligible caller can become admin via an env-token bootstrap handshake.
Couple-scoped authorization is enforced via a canonical coupleId derived from sorted principal text and a mutual-partnership check (both profiles must point to each other).
Frontend is a tab-based React SPA (no react-router) with BottomNav-driven navigation and page-level gating for auth/pairing state.

Canister I/O is centralized in @tanstack/react-query hooks (queries + mutations), with targeted invalidation/refetch and polling for partner synchronization (ritual status, quiz sync, insights/badges).
Authentication uses Internet Identity (@dfinity/auth-client) exposed via a React context provider; identity restoration occurs on mount and login/logout is UI-driven.
Sensitive bootstrap secrets (e.g., admin token) are read from the URL hash, persisted in sessionStorage, and removed from the URL to reduce leakage.
Photos are stored as blobs in-canister and rendered in the UI via direct blob URLs; access is restricted to owner/partner/admin.
UI uses Tailwind + shadcn-ui with OKLCH design tokens, custom animation classes, and prefers-reduced-motion overrides for accessibility/performance.
Client persistence is used for UX-only state (e.g., daily spin result, post-pairing highlight, “scroll to harmony” flag).
known_issues: Backend analytics are stubbed: getInsightsData() returns zeros/empty trend arrays; the Insights UI will show mostly empty/zero values despite polling.
Backend badge milestones are stubbed: getBadgeMilestones() always returns default (all false) milestone progress; badge unlocking does not reflect real behavior.
React Query is provided twice (QueryClientProvider in frontend/src/main.tsx and again inside frontend/src/App.tsx), creating multiple clients and potential cache inconsistency/confusion.
Frontend useArePromptsInitialized() is a stub that always returns true because a backend prompt-init status endpoint does not exist.
Backend prompt listing endpoints fetchPrompts()/getPromptsByLoveLanguage() do not call internalInitPrompts(); they can return empty until another call (e.g., getDailyRitual) triggers initialization.
Pairing codes have no expiration/TTL enforcement though UX copy mentions “expired” codes; codes persist until used/overwritten.
Blob-storage maintenance endpoint _caffeineStorageUpdateGatewayPrincipals() has no authorization check, allowing any caller to refresh the gateway principal list.
Environment variable typo: Storage.getCashierPrincipal reads CAFFFEINE_STORAGE_CASHIER_PRINCIPAL (triple “F”); misconfiguration will trap at runtime.
Storage.refillCashier uses Nat.sub(currentBalance, reservedCycles) and can trap if the canister balance is below the reserved amount.

CSS/animation mismatch risk: components use class names like animate-float-up, but the custom CSS defines completion-float-up (and not necessarily animate-float-up), so some celebration/float animations may not run as intended.
